kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Rs 115.82 = FY26 basic EPS of Rs 6.07 x 19.08, the lowest peer P/E in the DRHP's own table (Elin Electronics, p. 179). It is a reference point for sizing the model, not a price band and not a view of the right price. The DRHP's peer P/Es run from 19.08x to 526.00x (average 176.08x). The only priced transaction in the DRHP is the 29-Jan-2024 transfer among shareholders at Rs 34.66 per Rs 10 share, Rs 5.78 after the bonus and split (p. 190).

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: Operating cash flow +37.40 / -66.47 / -430.08 Rs m (FY24 / FY25 / FY26) against PAT 76.70 / 271.37 / 332.06; cumulative CFO/PAT -67.5% (-459.15 / 680.13). Operating profit before working capital was positive each year (633.64 in FY26); working capital absorbed Rs 962.71 m in FY26 (inventory Rs 1,017.90 m, receivables Rs 344.94 m, offset by payables Rs 596.42 m). FY26 CFO is also after Rs 74.96 m of foreign-exchange loss in other expenses and Rs 44.24 m of unrealised loss added back.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Demand side: top-10 customers 89.71% / 89.36% / 88.38% of revenue (FY26 / FY25 / FY24); Amber Enterprises India 28.79%; top-5 customers 75.36%. Supply side: top-10 suppliers 79.33% of expenses; Supplier 1 is 32.99% (22.74% in FY25). Amber Enterprises, the largest customer, is also named among the major suppliers (p. 26); the DRHP does not say how much is bought from it. 53.07% of raw materials are imported (South Korea, China, Thailand). The DRHP states there are no long-term contracts with the top-10 suppliers and purchases are by individual purchase order (p. 430). Both sides fail independently.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Related-party trade is small: purchases from KPM India / KPM International Rs 28.57 m (0.54% of FY26 revenue), sales Rs 2.65 m. Freehold land of Rs 4.99 m was bought from Koolking Foundation (a KMP-influenced entity) in FY26. Promoters lend to the company: unsecured loans of Rs 157.25 m were outstanding at 31-Jul-2026 (8.84% of borrowings, p. 37), and interest paid to promoters, relatives and their HUFs was Rs 13.97 m in FY26. Proceeds go to the company's own plants, not to a subsidiary.

focus.title: Contingent liabilities
focus.detail: Contingent liabilities Rs 133.46 m = 14.2% of net worth (Rs 941.17 m) and 30.2% of FY26 PBT; Rs 130.38 m is a customs show-cause notice (22-Apr-2025) on ASEAN-India FTA duty exemption. The High Court dismissed the writ on 28-Apr-2026; a special leave petition (29-May-2026) is pending at the Supreme Court. Not provided for.

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: Statutory auditor Raj Kumar Jindal & Co resigned 20-Sep-2025 (stated reason: preoccupation with other professional arrangements) after re-appointment on 30-Sep-2024; SCV & Co. LLP was appointed 30-Sep-2025 to fill the vacancy and audited FY26. FY25 and FY24 are special-purpose financial statements. Auditors' reports carry observations on audit trail and on title deeds (p. 59).

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: CARO / Rule 11(g): audit trail was partly enabled at application level and not at database level throughout FY26. Title deeds of Plot UDL-7 (Gross value Rs 32.22 m, Andhra Pradesh) are not yet in the company's name (held since March 2025; sale deed pending).

focus.title: Lead-manager track record
focus.detail: Keynote Financial Services is BRLM. This DRHP lists two IPOs handled in FY27: Amir Chand Jagdish Kumar (Exports), -23.53% at day 30 and -15.98% at day 90; CSM Technologies, -2.75% at day 30. Neither has a 180-day reading. Both are recorded in data/merchant_bankers.json.

comfort.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
comfort.detail: 2:1 bonus (record date 21-Aug-2026, allotted 1-Sep-2026) and 1:2 split (3-Sep-2026) are applied retrospectively: EPS 6.07 / 4.96 / 1.43 and NAV 17.20 are on 54,729,240 shares. The balance sheet still shows share capital of Rs 91.22 m (pre-bonus count of 9,121,540 shares of Rs 10), which is a presentation point only.

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Current tax Rs 107.51 m of a Rs 110.42 m FY26 charge; cumulative current tax is 25.4% of cumulative PBT (236.94 / 933.13 Rs m) against a 25.17% statutory rate. Tax actually paid was Rs 155.57 m over three years, so Rs 92.03 m sits as current tax payable at 31-Mar-2026 (Rs 16.98 m at FY24).

comfort.detail: Monitoring agency to be appointed (issue above Rs 1,000 m). No debt-repayment object. Land for the three new units is already owned and is not funded from proceeds.

comfort.title: Eligibility re-computation
comfort.detail: Reg 6(1) re-performed: operating profit 533.77 / 429.41 / 135.94 Rs m reproduces from PBT plus finance cost less other income (442.48 + 117.60 - 26.31 = 533.77); three-year average Rs 366.37 m against the Rs 150 m test; net tangible assets Rs 940.50 / 607.46 / 333.72 m; monetary assets 13.76% / 16.28% / 17.33% of NTA; net worth above Rs 10 m each year. KPI EBITDA Rs 573.88 m reproduces from the P&L.

comfort.title: SME conditions
comfort.detail: OFS of 3,050,000 shares by four selling shareholders (915,000 each from three promoters; 305,000 from a promoter-group member), each below half of its holding. At the Rs 115.82 reference the OFS is Rs 353.3 m, 10.5% of a Rs 3353.3 m offer (under the 20% ceiling). Re-test at the RHP price.
